work_title: Revise and optimize hashCode for Digest32 and other hashes (#197)
description: Derive hashCode of hash-carrying classes (Input/DataInput/UnsignedInput, ErgoHeader, CHeader, extended keys) from the first bytes of the underlying 256-bit hash via Ints.fromByteArray, keeping Arrays.hashCode only as a fallback for arrays shorter than 4 bytes. Covered by HashCodeSpecification and extended-key tests.
